title: Control the grace clock when a held file capture completes after named-root close
outcome: named_root_capture_applied_after_actual_observation_close_stays_resolved checks held-capture completion order and resolution independently of physical grace expiry.
acceptance: The test retains its parked capture, actual close, zero-unresolved result and exact late-summary assertions, with controlled time at the grace-admission boundary.
Production grace and attribution policies are unchanged; no timeout increase, retry, skip or ignore is used.
